# Municipal Ordinance No. 10, Series of 2017

**Creating the Position of Sanitation Inspector 1 — SG-6/1 in the Office of the Municipal Health Officer in the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon**

Resolution No. 163

## Summary

Creates the position of **Sanitation Inspector 1** with Salary Grade 6, Step 1 (SG-6/1) in the [[Municipal Health Office]] of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. The position is intended to strengthen the municipality's sanitation and health inspection capacity.

Motioned by [[Timoteo F. Villaflor Jr.]], seconded by [[Esperanza A. Tan]], [[Adam M. Forbes]], and [[Rubi A. De Asis]].

Absent during session: [[Carlos T. Gliane II]] (on leave).

## Key Provisions

- **Position Created:** Sanitation Inspector 1
- **Salary Grade:** SG-6/1
- **Office Assignment:** Municipal Health Office
- **Purpose:** Strengthen sanitation inspection and health regulation capacity
